blocks.text: Nucleus ka structure (banawat) samajhne ke liye un forces ko janna zaroori hai jo nucleons ko jor kar rakhti hain. Is se pehle nature (qudrat) ki basic forces janna chahiye. Universe (kaainat) bohat complex (uljha hua) lagta hai, phir bhi is ke tamam interactions (aapas ke asar) sirf chaar basic forces se chalte hain, jinhein fundamental forces kehte hain. Yeh forces tay karti hain ke chhote atoms se le kar bari galaxies tak cheezein kaise move karti hain, aapas mein kaise asar daalti hain aur kaise behave karti hain. Chaar fundamental forces: gravity, electromagnetism, weak nuclear force aur strong nuclear force.

Gravitational force (gravity) chaaron mein sab se weak (kamzor) hai magar long-range (door tak asar karne wali) hai. Yeh hamesha attractive (apni taraf kheenchne wali) force hai jo bodies ke darmiyan hoti hai. Do bodies ke darmiyan gravity un ke masses ke product (zarb) ke proportional aur un ke darmiyan faasle ke square ke inversely proportional (ulat) hai. Suraj ya bare planets jaisi bhaari bodies ke liye yeh bohat important hai kyun ke un ke masses bare hain, magar atom ke level par yeh itni kamzor hai ke isay neglect (nazar-andaz) kar sakte hain.

Electromagnetic force electric aur magnetic fields ke asar ki zimmedar hai. Gravity ki tarah yeh bhi inverse square law (faasle ke square ke ulat) par chalti hai, magar gravity se kahin zyada strong (taaqatwar) hai. Atom ke structure aur chemical bonding se le kar bijli, magnetism aur roshni ke aage barhne (propagation) tak bohat si cheezein isi se chalti hain. James Clerk Maxwell (1861) ne chaar basic equations banayin jinhon ne bijli aur magnetism ko mila kar electromagnetism bana diya. Yeh equations batati hain ke electric aur magnetic fields aapas mein kaise asar karti hain aur electromagnetic waves kaise aage barhti hain. In se pata chala ke electric aur magnetic fields alag forces nahi balke ek hi electromagnetic force ke do roop (aspects) hain.

Chaar fundamental forces mein nuclear forces sab se strong attractive (kheenchne wali) forces hain. Electromagnetism matter (maadde) ko jor kar rakhta hai, magar is se yeh pata nahi chalta tha ke atom mein nucleus kaise jura rehta hai. Agar sirf electromagnetism aur gravity hon to protons ek doosre ko dhakel kar (repulsion) nucleus ko bikher dein. Nucleus ki stability (qaim rehna) batati hai ke nucleus ke andar koi aur force hai jo gravity aur electromagnetic force dono se strong hai: yahan nuclear forces kaam aati hain. Strong nuclear force atoms ke nuclei ko jor kar rakhti hai. Yeh sirf nucleus ke andar hoti hai, is liye isay short-range (bohat kam faasle tak) force kehte hain. Strong nuclear force tamam nucleons (protons aur neutrons dono) ke darmiyan ek jaisi attractive force hai. Yani protons strong force se ek doosre ko kheenchte bhi hain aur saath hi electric force se dhakelte bhi hain. Neutron par koi charge nahi, phir bhi woh strong force se doosre neutrons ya protons ko kheenchta hai. Weak nuclear force radioactive decay, khaas taur par beta decay, aur neutrino wale interactions ki zimmedar hai. Baqi forces ke ulat weak force particles ki identity (pehchaan) badal sakti hai, maslan neutron ko proton bana deti hai; is liye yeh sitaron mein nuclear fusion aur unstable nuclei ke decay ke liye zaroori hai. Chaaron forces ki relative (ek doosre ke muqable mein) strength aur range Table 12.1 mein di gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: Strong nuclear force aur electric force mein kya similarity (milti julti baat) aur kya difference (farq) hai (short question 12.3)? Strong force nucleus ko kaise jor kar rakhti hai (short question 12.7)?
blocks.explanation: Similarity: dono fundamental forces hain jo nucleus ke particles par lagti hain, aur dono gravity se kahin zyada strong hain. Difference neeche table mein hai. Nucleus ke andar paas paas ke nucleons ki strong attraction protons ke darmiyan electric repulsion (dhakel) se zyada hoti hai, is liye nucleons jure rehte hain; neutrons repulsion barhaye baghair attraction barhate hain.

rows: Sirf charged particles par lagti hai
Tamam nucleons par lagti hai (protons aur neutrons par barabar)
Attract bhi kar sakti hai aur repel (dhakel) bhi
Inverse square se kam hoti hai; range infinite
Range sirf taqreeban 10⁻¹⁵ m (nucleus ke andar)

items: Chaar fundamental forces: gravity (sab se weak, long-range, sirf attraction), electromagnetic (inverse square, gravity se kahin strong; Maxwell 1861), strong (sab se strong, short-range, tamam nucleons mein attraction, nucleus ko jor kar rakhti hai), weak (beta decay aur neutrinos; particles ki identity badalti hai).
Table 12.1: strong 1 (< 10⁻¹⁵ m), electromagnetic 10⁻² (∞), weak 10⁻¹³ (< 10⁻¹⁸ m), gravity 10⁻³⁸ (∞).
